$comment: The verses in plain words: explanations of what each cited verse means, following the classical commentators, written for this project. Not translations of the Quran; shown labelled as explanations (src/ui/scripture.ts). Loaded with its own chunk (src/ui/plain-words.ts).
plain.2:117: He brought the heavens and the earth into being when nothing like them existed. When He decides on something, He only says to it, “Be!”, and it is.
plain.7:54: Your Lord is Allah, who created the heavens and the earth in six Days, then rose above the Throne. He covers the day with the night, which follows it swiftly; and the sun, the moon and the stars are made to serve by His command. Creation and command are His alone. Blessed is Allah, Lord of all the worlds.
plain.14:48: On that Day the earth will be changed into a different earth, and the heavens too, and everyone will come out before Allah, the One, the All-Powerful.
plain.21:30: Do those who reject faith not see that the heavens and the earth were once joined together, and that We split them apart? And We made every living thing from water. Will they still not believe?
plain.21:33: He is the One who created the night and the day, the sun and the moon, each moving along in its own orbit.
plain.21:104: On that Day We will roll up the sky as a written scroll is rolled up. Just as We began the first creation, We will bring it back again: a promise binding on Us, and We will surely carry it out.
plain.22:47: They ask you to hurry on the punishment, but Allah never breaks His promise. A day with your Lord is like a thousand years as you count them.
plain.24:45: Allah created every creature from water. Some of them crawl on their bellies, some walk on two legs and some on four. Allah creates whatever He wills; He has power over everything.
plain.25:59: He created the heavens and the earth and everything between them in six Days, then rose above the Throne: the Most Merciful. Ask about Him one who truly knows.
plain.32:4: Allah is the One who created the heavens and the earth and everything between them in six Days, then rose above the Throne. Apart from Him you have no protector and no one to plead for you. Will you not take heed?
plain.32:5: He directs every matter from the heavens to the earth; then it rises back up to Him in a Day whose length is a thousand years as you count them.
plain.36:38: And the sun runs on to its appointed resting place. That is the plan of the Almighty, the All-Knowing.
plain.36:39: And for the moon We have set stages, until it becomes again like an old, dried, curved palm stalk.
plain.36:40: The sun cannot overtake the moon, and the night cannot get ahead of the day: each is moving along in its own orbit.
plain.36:82: When He wills something, His only command is to say to it, “Be!”, and it is.
plain.39:6: He created you all from a single soul, then made its mate from it, and He provided you with eight kinds of livestock in pairs. He forms you in your mothers’ wombs, stage after stage, within three layers of darkness. That is Allah, your Lord; the kingdom is His. There is no god but Him, so how can you turn away?
plain.39:67: They have not valued Allah as He truly deserves. On the Day of Resurrection the whole earth will be within His grasp, and the heavens rolled up in His right hand. Glorified and exalted is He above the partners they claim for Him.
plain.41:9: Say: Do you really reject the One who created the earth in two Days, and set up rivals to Him? He is the Lord of all the worlds.
plain.41:10: He placed firm mountains on it, standing high above it, blessed it, and measured out its provisions in four Days, the same for all who ask.
plain.41:11: Then He turned to the heaven while it was smoke, and said to it and to the earth, “Come, willingly or unwillingly.” They said, “We come willingly.”
plain.41:12: So He made them seven heavens in two Days, and gave each heaven its command. We adorned the nearest heaven with lamps and kept it guarded. That is the plan of the Almighty, the All-Knowing.
plain.50:38: We created the heavens and the earth and everything between them in six Days, and no tiredness touched Us.
plain.51:47: We built the heaven with strength, and it is We who give it its vastness.
plain.55:33: O jinn and humans, if you are able to pass beyond the regions of the heavens and the earth, then pass beyond them! You cannot, except with authority from Allah.
plain.57:25: We sent Our messengers with clear signs, and sent down with them the Scripture and the Balance, so that people would uphold justice. And We sent down iron, with its great strength and many benefits for people, so that Allah might make known who supports Him and His messengers without seeing Him. Allah is Strong and Almighty.
plain.65:12: Allah is the One who created seven heavens, and of the earth the like of them. His command comes down through them all, so that you may know that Allah has power over everything and that His knowledge encompasses all things.
plain.67:3: He created seven heavens, one above another. You will see no flaw in what the Most Merciful creates. Look again: can you see any cracks?
plain.70:4: The angels and the Spirit rise up to Him in a Day whose length is fifty thousand years.
plain.79:30: And after that He spread out the earth,
plain.79:31: brought out of it its water and its pasture,
plain.79:32: and set the mountains firmly in place,
plain.81:1: When the sun is wrapped up and its light is gone,
plain.81:2: and when the stars fall and lose their light,
plain.82:1: When the sky is split apart,
plain.82:2: and when the stars are scattered,
plain.86:11: By the sky, which brings back the rain again and again,
